methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 electric countertop oil-immersion deep fryers (distinct from air fryers) spanning entry-level compact models through large dual-basket units from Presto, T-fal, Hamilton Beach, Cuisinart, Breville, Secura, Chefman, and Elite Gourmet. Specs were independently re-verified against official manufacturer product pages (gopresto.com, t-fal.com, hamiltonbeach.com, cuisinart.com, breville.com, chefman.com, shopelitegourmet.com) and corroborated via major retailer listings (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Lowe's, Best Buy) plus user-manual repositories. Booleans (adjustable_thermostat, viewing_window) are true when the feature is explicitly documented and null when neither presence nor absence is confirmed on the manufacturer page; oil_capacity_l is the manufacturer-stated oil fill volume in liters; food_capacity_lb is the stated per-batch food load in pounds; wattage_w and max_temp_f are nameplate values; basket_count is the number of fry baskets included; priceUsd reflects the US MSRP or typical published retail price verified at time of access. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Adversarial pass: all 11 products verified to exist; prices confirmed on manufacturer pages; Breville max_temp filled from manual; Elite Gourmet wattage held at manufacturer-stated 1500W (third-party 2000W listings rejected); two source URLs corrected to canonical manufacturer pages.

Official t-fal.com product page (EZ Clean Deep Fryer 1.8 Liters, SKU 7211419066, Model Number FR702D51) confirms: 1.8 L oil capacity, up to 1.7 pounds food capacity, adjustable temperature 300°F to 375°F (max_temp_f=375), an adjustable thermostat ("Turn the adjustable thermostat to the desired temperature"), a locking lid with large viewing window, a single cooking basket, and a $129.99 price; the manufacturer page does not state wattage. Amazon retailer listing (B0CGMD1VNV) explicitly resolves to the exact FR702D51 unit and the 1.8 L / 1200 W variant (title, selected size "1.8 L- 1200 W", and product-info block: Model Number FR702D51, Wattage 1200 watts, Oil Capacity 1.8 Liters): it states "Wattage 1200 watts" (distinct from the 3.5 L / 1700 W and 3.5 L / 1800 W siblings) and corroborates the same 1.8 L oil, 1.7 lb food, 300-375°F range, immersed heating element, adjustable thermostat, and large viewing window. wattage_w=1200 is sourced from the Amazon page since t-fal.com omits it; releaseDate is not stated on either fetched page, so it is left null. Exact model FR702D51 confirmed on both pages; not a sibling/other capacity.
